A small polish for the Computer panel.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.1.4.exe`** below and run it. It installs over 1.1.x and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- No auto-update: install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## What's changed

- **Open shows on hover.** The Open button on the Computer preview (the bot's computer and This PC) now stays out of the way and fades in when you hover the preview, or when you Tab to it with the keyboard. Clicking anywhere on the preview opens the large view.
- The status dot and the refresh button are unchanged.
